clips.title: The story
paras: This trial marks the second stage of a tauren hunter's initiation into the art of beast taming. Guided by hunter trainer Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village, the novice is charged with mastering the swift and fearless prairie stalker.

Having successfully mastered the defensive endurance of the adult plainstrider, Yaw Sharpmane challenges the young hunter to look beyond mere survival. The prairie stalker represents an entirely different hunting philosophy: relentless speed, pack coordination, and fearless aggression. To tame one requires approaching a cunning predator without breaking stride, mirroring the wolf's own decisive nature.

For the tauren, hunting with a beast is never about servitude or raw subjugation. Yaw Sharpmane stresses that the hunter and predator must fight as one cohesive unit, bound by mutual respect and shared rhythm. By bonding with the prairie stalker under the open skies of Mulgore, the hunter learns to complement a partner's assault and move in tandem during the heat of battle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have a fiery spirit, hunter, readily awaiting your next challenge.
Your next task is to gain the companionship of a wolf known as the prairie stalker. This creature is swift and fearless; in taking this beast as your pet, you must also take on these qualities.
During a battle, you will learn how you and your pet will become a team. In the end you must work as one, muscle to muscle.
Here is the taming rod, friend. Tame a prairie stalker and practice your skills.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found a prairie stalker?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes... The Earthmother believes that you are ready for the next lesson.
